limits: Pressure counts and extrema summarize emitted WJ_CEP_VALUE records only; positive pressure is a local point observation.
A zero-emitted result means no point records appeared before a complete per-tie WJ_E_IF row; it does not independently establish no contact or no force.
The force resultant is the norm of the integrated slave-side CFN vector; the master vector is reported separately. Exact printed zero/nonzero detection uses no engineering threshold.
First event times cover this bounded prefix only and do not establish a complete accepted-state history or mechanics result.

read_bounds.policy: single forward read from byte zero; no follow, polling, seeking, or reads beyond max_bytes

semantics_binding.WJ_ANGULAR_role: CFN slave/master first three values are integrated total surface force; master is preserved for action-reaction comparison
semantics_binding.WJ_E_IF_role: the source emits this tie's scalar after its CF-loop CEP point rows; a finite row frames that pair's point emission list
semantics_binding.time_join: same printed state time uses sum of half-last-digit quanta; no step/increment ID is present on CEP tags
